findings.detail: Cost currency was assigned GBP from the Par / Units column for Armstrong Bidco Limited first lien senior secured loan; the cost value belongs to the USD valuation column.
Cost currency was assigned GBP from the Par / Units column for Armstrong Bidco Limited delayed draw term loan; the cost value belongs to the USD valuation column.

rationale: FX03 is confirmed. The raw SOI rows show the pound currency marker in the Par / Units column, while Amortized Cost and Fair Value are separate valuation columns that roll into dollar-denominated investment totals. The extracted cost_currency of GBP for both flagged Armstrong Bidco rows is therefore a currency-assignment extraction error, not a valid non-USD cost valuation.
